AsyncEffect to
If {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert#currentState} is `Closed`:
  Transition {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert#currentState} from `Closed` to `Open`.
  Update `secondaryActionButtonTitle` in {@link ReliabilityApplicationState}.
Else if {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert#currentState} is `Open`:
  Open modal to confirm closing and submit feedback as handled by {@link UiSdlEpicSubmitAlertAndModelFeedback}
